decisions.reason: The award at launch and the strong fit with the firm's geothermal and materials capabilities make this a valuable option whose upside is not yet exhausted and whose continuation likely costs little.
As a closely related geothermal variant, it preserves market coverage and learning in a growing application area, so we would keep the option open despite limited later evidence.

Because this is a broader geothermal surface-technology line with several models built on existing know-how, it offers portfolio value and is worth retaining while demand uncertainty continues to resolve.
The fire-protection profile system is close to the core building-systems business and likely has durable customer relevance, so keeping it is a low-risk way to preserve upside.

The slim steel profile system fits the established profile business, but with no clear positive signal after launch it is a somewhat weaker option that we would still retain for now because exit costs are likely low.

The decorative surface system appears less central to the firm's technical-value proposition and, without visible evidence of traction, is the most likely candidate to be discontinued and free resources for stronger core options.
